//: Workspace settings for the Prism repo. Wires VSCode JSON validation to the in-repo schema bundle under schema/v1/ — the same bundle prism init extracts into .prism/schemas/ for downstream projects. Edit schema/v1/spec.schema.json (and siblings) and VSCode picks up changes immediately; no init / copy step.
//urn: CAVEAT: when a document declares its own "$schema", VSCode resolves THAT value and ignores the fileMatch associations below. Every committed *.prism.json declares "$schema": "urn:prism:schema:v1:spec", which VSCode cannot fetch (unknown URI scheme) — it reports 'Unable to load schema' and gives no completion. The fix is a URN shim entry in machine-level User settings (json.schemas entry with url "urn:prism:schema:v1:spec" and an inline schema { "$ref": "file:///abs/path/to/prism/schema/v1/spec.schema.json" }); it needs an absolute path, so it cannot live in this committed file. The associations below still cover drafts that omit $schema, plus any file whose $schema is a relative path form (the spec schema accepts ./…/spec.schema.json and file:// forms).
